translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús miliatar-dulemar masgi oguchad
We degi-gusad-sorbali, Jesús Galilea-mata-dummad-obakar nade-gusad. We-mata-dummad Tiberias-mataye-nugbalid.
Dulemar-bukidar Jesúsba nade-gusmalad, ar ade ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid dule-uelemaladgi-imakdiid daksamalad.
Agi Jesús yar-birse nakwisgu, e-sapinganmala agi sigdapmalad.
Deun Judiomar-iba, Bab-Dummad-Israel-Dulemar-Egiptogi-Wilebukwa-Onosad-Iba bato omosad.
Jesús atakdegu, dakded, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimala. Agi Felipega sogded: —¿Wemar madu gunmalagar, wede bia anmar madu bakoe?
Unnila binsa Felipe-wilubdakega Jesús weyob Felipega sogsa-gusad, ar edi na bato wisid igi imakoe.
Felipe, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dule-wargwen nii-walabaabak-arbana-bennukleged, a-manigi madu baklesale, amba unnisuliled, belagwapa wis madu bipi-bipi gunmalagar.
Geb degi e-sapin-baid, Andrés, Simón-Pedro-e-urba, Jesúsga sogded:
—Wegi machigwa-wargwen cebada-madu-gwaatar wis sediid, degine, ua-burwigana wis ukabo sedibalid, degite, ¿ar wede unniosi, ar dule bukidarad?
Jesús degi sogded: —Nabir. Dulemar be urbemar. A-degi-gunanaidgine, gagan bukidar naid. Agi dulemar ambikusmargu, miliatar-wilub machergan mergu daklealid.

Jesús madu susgua, Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsagu, e-sapinganga madu uke-uke imaksad. Geb e-sapingan dulemar-gagan-birgi-bukmaladga ukdemogad. Jesús amba deyob ua-imaksabalid, ar bule-mergu abemaladba ega uksamalad.
Bela dulemar immelesmargu, Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —Bela gwabgusmalad be wemar, adi mer binsa mas milegegar.
Cebada-madu-gwaataled bela guchamalad-sorba, gwabgusmalad wesmargu, garba-gwaambe-gakabo-mergu enosmar daklealid.
Ar dulemar Jesús-madu-gwaataled-omelosad-daksamalad, sogdemalad: —We inso Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged we-napnegse-nonikoed-sunnadye.
Ar ise-ebipiar reyga-guega e-imakdanimalo, Jesús dulemar-daksagu, e-iduar yarse walagwen banguded.
Jesús demar-birgi nanasad
Dad argwategu, Jesús-sapingan demar-gakase aidenonimalad igi ega Jesús-sogsa-gusadgii.
Urgi nakwismargu, mata-dummad obakdemalad, Capernaumse. Deun bato neg nue mutikgusad, Jesúsdi e-sapinganse amba yo nonikid.
Ar burwa binnasur gormaisoggu, demar dunguded.
Jesús-sapingan kilómetro-atargus, igi, nergwagus gammimaladgine, dakarmalad, Jesús demar-birgi nanadani, e-urse warmakdani. Deyob dakarmargu, dobguarmalad.
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Ani an gudii, mer be dobgumar.
Degi e-sapingan weligwar urgi Jesús-abingasmalad, degine, bia-na-nadapmaladse warmaksamarsunnad.
Dulemar Jesús-amidii-gusmalad
A-banedgine, dulemar-bukidar-Jesúsba-mata-obakar-gudimaladi dakarmalad unnila ur-wargwen-nai-gusadi, sate. A-urgi Jesús na e-sapinganba nakwissulid, unnila e-sapinganbi nade-gusmalad.
Ur-baigandi Tiberias-neggweburgi-danimalad nagunonimalad, bia Dummad-Jesús Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogsad-sorba madu-omelosad guchamaladgi.
Ar dulemar Jesús-daklesur dakargu, degi, e-sapingan satemoga, Jesús-amiegala, urgi nade-gusmalad, Capernaumse.
Jesús sogsa-gusad, ede madu-burba-duladye
Dulemar mata-dummad-obakar Jesús-amismargu, ega sogdemar: —¿Odurdaked-saila, sana wese be noniki?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, emarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, be an-amimaladi, an-ibmar-dakledisulid-imaksadba be an-amisurmalad, ar bemar madu-immedik-guchadba be an-amimalad.

Mas-baisursunna-bergumaladga mer be arbamar. Be arbamar, mas anmarga burba-geg-bergued-uked-degi-sadeguoedga. Ar a-masdi sunna bemarga, ani Dule-Machi, an ukoed, ar agala Bab Dummad bato angi e-wilub nasiksad, we angi burba-geg-bergued nikumalagar.
Degi, Jesús-abin sogdemarsun: —¿Degite, igi an imakmalosunna Bab Dummadga ibmar-imakega?
Jesús, abin-imakde, emarga sogded: —Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-imaked wedo, Bab-Dummad-bemarga-na-dule-barmialidgi, mer agi be bengumar.
Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —¿Degite, ibi-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid be anmarga imakosunna, adi anmar dakega, begi anmar mer benguega Bab Dummad be-barmialid? ¿Ibi-ibmar be imaksunna?
¿Bedi ibi anmarga ukosunna? Ar anmar-dadgan nega-dule-sulidgangi maná-guchamalad, ar Bab-Dummad-Garda sognaid:
Jesús amarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged, Moisés bemarga madu-nibneggi-danikid uksasulid, ar an-Bab madu-nibneggi-danikid-sunnad bemarga uked.
Ar Bab-Dummad-madu, we-dule-nibneggi-aidenonikid, we-napnegginmaladga burba-dula-gudiguedi uked.
Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Dummad, madu-degiid be anmarga ukdigu-sae.
Jesús, abin-sogded: “Ani an madu-burba-duladid. Ar dule anse danikile, bar gwen ukumesosulid. Ar dule an-bengusulile, bar gwen uku-uku itogosulid.
“Ar an bemarga epenne bato sogsamalad, ibmar-dakledisulid-imaksad be an-daksamar-inigwele, degite amba be an-benmalad.
Ar bela Bab dulemar-anga-ukedi, anse dagoed anba naguegar. Ar dule anse danikile, gwen an barmetosulid.
“Ar nibneggi an danikid, an-itoleged na ibmar-saega an danisulid. An nonikid, dule-an-barmialid-sogedba ibmar-imakegar.
Bab-an-barmialid we abemaid: Bela dulemar-anse-nonikid gwen wargwensaar oyoggubisur an-abeged, adi ibagan-napi-naguoedgi a-dulemar an gannar odulogegar.
“Dule-an-barmialid we abemaid: Bela dulemar-E-Machi-dakedi, degine, egi bensuli-gunonikile, burba-geg-bergued nikuoed. Degine, ani, ibagan-napi-naguoedgi a-dule an odulogoed.”
Degi Judiomar Jesúsgi sunmakedbi-guarmalad, ar ade Jesús sogsad: “Ani an madu-nibneggi-aidenonikidye.”
Judiomar Jesúsgi sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede Jesússursi, José-machisursi, degine, e-bab, degi, e-nan anmar mag daksursi? ¿Ar degite ibiga sogsunna, nibneggi an aidenoniye?
Jesús amar-abin imakde, sogded: —Mer na be muchub-muchub angi istar sunmakmar.
Dule-wargwensaale gege anse daged, ar Bab-an-barmialid, a anse-dagega imaksulir, ibagan-napi-naguoedgi, ani an a-dule-odulogoed.
Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-gardagi narmakar naid:
Is. 54:13 Degisoggu, bela Bab-itosmalad, degi, egi durdaksamarbalid, amar anse danimaloed anba naguegar.
“Ar an sogsulid, dule-wargwensaar Bab-daksa-deeye. Suli, unnila dule-Bab-Dummadgi-danikid, abi unnila Bab-daksad.
Napira an bemarga soged: Ar dule angi bengusulile, a-dule burba-geg-bergued nikad.
“Ani an madu-burba-duladid.
Ar be-dadgan nega-dule-sulidgangi maná guchamar-inigwele, amar bela burgwismalad.
“An bemarga madu-nibneggi-aidenonikidgi an sunmakedi, a-madu dule guchale, adi geg bar burgwed.

Ani an madu-duladid, nibneggi-aidenonikidid. Ar dule-wargwen a-madu guchale, bar burgosulid, degi-dula-sadeguoed. An madu-ukoedi, we an-sanad. An a-madu ukoed, adi we-napneg-naidgi dulemar-bukmalad dula gudiguegar.”
Agi Judiomar na abin-abin imakarmalad, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede anmar e-san-gunnega anmarga na e-san ukode? Adi surbali.
Jesús amarga sogded: —Napira an bemarga soged: Ar bemar Dule-Machi-e-san-gunsulile, degine, e-abe gobsurbalile, bemar burba-dulad-satemalad.
Ar dule an-san gunnele, degi, an-abe gobele, a-dule burba-geg-bergued nikado, degine, ibagan-napi-naguoedgi, ani an a-dule-odulogoed.
Ar an-sana, mas-gunned-sunsogedid, degine, an-abe, gobed-sunsogedbalid.
Ar dule-an-san-gunmalad, degi, an-abe-gobmalad, anginbi gudigumalad, degine, an egi gudigumogad.
Ar igi Bab-dula-gudiid an-barmiali, degine, igi an Babgi an dula gudimoga, dule an-san guchale, deyob a-dule angi dula gudigumogoed.
Ar ani an madu-nibneggi-aidesadid. Be-dadgan-maná-guchadyobsulid, ar amardi burgwismalad. Ar madu-nibneggi-aidesadi, dule a-madu guchardi, adi burgosulid, degi-sadeguoed.
Jesús we-ibmar-sogsagusadi, Judiomar-onmaked-neggi sogsa-gusdo, deun Capernaumgi dulemar-odurdaksigusgu.
Bukidar Jesúsgi bangudmalad
Bukidar-e-sapingan Jesús weyob-soge itosmargu, sogdemalad: —We-ibmar-sogedi gwen nollo sogsulid. Degisoggu, we deyob-sogedba, ¿ar doa eba ibsaoe? Anmar eba ibsaosurmala.
Ar Jesús na wissoggu, e-sapingan na muchub-muchub we-igargi sunmaknanaid, amarga sogdesun: —¿Ar we-an-bemarga-sogedi, be istar itomala?
Degite, ¿igi be sogsamalarsunna, ar Dule-Machi nibneggi-bia-mai-gusadse gannar nakwemai be dakarmalar?
Ar Bab-Dummad-Burbabi dula gudigued uked, dule-sandi binsaledid. An-bemarga-ibmar-sogsadi, we burba-napiragwadid, degine, dula gudiguedbalid.
Ar bemar gwenna-gwennagwa an-benmalad. Ar Jesús bato gebesaila-akar wisid doamala e-benmala, degine, doa darba e-ukoe.
Jesús sogded: —A-ulale an sogsad, dule anba naguegala gege anse dagye, ar Bab anse sedasulir.
Degidgine, bukidar e-sapingan Jesús-metemalad, bar Jesúsba gudigussurmalad.
Geb degi Jesús na e-sapingan-warambe-gakabogwadga sokar: —¿Ar bemar nabimarmoga?
Simón-Pedro, abin-sogded: —Dummad, ¿doaba anmar naosunna? Ar bebi unnila igar-napiragwad nikad, dulemar burba-geg-bergued nikuegar.
Ar anmar begi bensulid, degine, anmar wisid, be Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maid-E-Machi-sunnadid.
Jesús, Pedro-abin sogded: —¿Ar warambe-gakabo an be-susmarsursi, ar bemar-gwensak niasursi?
Judas-Iscariote, Simón-e-machi, a-nik Jesús deyob sogsa-gusad, ar a-dule Jesús-darba-uknai-guoedid, e-sapingan-e-ambe-gakabogwad-wargwen.
